_help.about: liteAECO Contract Obligations dictionary. One file = one language/jurisdiction. All keys are English so anyone can adapt it.

keys.app: Must be liteAECO-contract-dictionary. Identifies the file.
keys.defaults: Config applied when this dictionary is selected: currency, dateLocale (dach|us|uk|iso), vatRate (%), rentPeriod (monthly|annual — how rent figures are stated), highlight toggles.
keys.id: Unique short id, e.g. de-CH, en-UK, fr-CH.
keys.name: Shown in the dictionary selector.
keys.tocHeaders: Lines that mark a table of contents. The block after them is removed before analysis.
keys.clauses: Keywords highlighted blue (Clause heatmap). Word-boundary at start, case-insensitive.
keys.coreAudit: Baselines that MUST appear. Missing ones are listed in red.
keys.fields: Structured values extracted into cards. Order = evaluation order. Field ids are fixed by the app.

fieldKeys.id: Fixed app id: landlord, tenant, address, purpose, area, netRent, totalRent, serviceCharges, deposit, vatNumber, vat, startDate, term, noticePeriod, exclusivity, sublease.
fieldKeys.label: Label used in exports and dropdowns.
fieldKeys.description: Free text for humans. Ignored by the app.
fieldKeys.type: text | money | number | date | area | flag. Drives the derived panel.
fieldKeys.pattern: JavaScript regex as a JSON string. Escape backslashes: \\d not \d.
fieldKeys.flags: Regex flags. i = ignore case, m = multiline (^ matches line start), s = dot matches newline. g is added automatically.
fieldKeys.group: Capture group index to keep. 0 = whole match.
fieldKeys.fallback: Second pattern tried only when 'pattern' finds nothing.
fieldKeys.suffix: Text appended on the card, e.g. ' CHF'.
fieldKeys.yes: flag type only: text shown when found.
fieldKeys.no: flag type only: text shown when not found.

regexCheatSheet: Same line only: use [^\\n] instead of . or \\s
Lazy skip:      Keyword.*?CHF                          nearest CHF after keyword

fields.label: Vermieter / Eigentümer
fields.description: Name after 'Vermieter' or 'Eigentümer', same or next line, must start with a capital.

fields.label: Mieter
fields.description: Name after 'Mieter'. Case-sensitive so 'Vermieter' does not match.

fields.label: Adresse / Objekt
fields.description: Text after an address keyword up to a 4-digit Swiss postcode + town. Max 2 line breaks.

fields.label: Zweck & Branche
fields.description: Rest of the line after a purpose keyword, up to the first full stop.

fields.label: Nettomietzins (CHF)
fields.description: First CHF amount after 'Netto'. Same line.

fields.label: Total (CHF)
fields.description: First CHF amount after Total / Gesamt / Brutto. Same line.

fields.label: Nebenkosten (CHF)
fields.description: First CHF amount after Nebenkosten. Same line.

fields.label: Kaution (CHF)
fields.description: First CHF amount after Mietzinsdepot / Kaution / Sicherheit. Same line.

fields.label: MWST
fields.description: Only checks presence. Details must be read in the text.

fields.label: Mietbeginn
fields.description: Date after Mietbeginn / beginnt am / Mietantritt. Accepts dd.mm.yyyy, yyyy.mm.dd, yyyy-mm-dd, '1. Juni 2026'.

fields.label: Mindestdauer (Jahre)
fields.description: Years after a duration keyword. Fallback: any 'N Jahre'.

fields.label: Kündigungsfrist (Monate)
fields.description: Months after Kündigungsfrist / Frist. Same line.
